# Splitter

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSplitter` · **Group:** [Layout and structure](../Groups/Layout-and-structure.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSplitPane.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSplitPane.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasSplitPane.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Resizable panes

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSplitter(const std::string& id, SplitOrientation orient, UltraCanvasSplitPane* owner);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

This class declares no callbacks of its own.

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `SplitOrientation`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Horizontal` | panes laid out left-to-right; splitter is a vertical strip |
| `Vertical` | panes laid out top-to-bottom; splitter is a horizontal strip |

### enum `SplitterHandleShape`

Shape of the optional grab handle drawn on the split line.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoHandle` | no handle (default) — the split line is a plain strip |
| `Square` | sharp-cornered rectangle |
| `RoundedSquare` | rectangle with SplitterHandleStyle::cornerRadius corners |
| `Round` | fully rounded: a circle when square, a capsule when elongated |
| `Image` | the handle IS the image at SplitterHandleStyle::imagePath |

### struct `SplitterHandleStyle`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `shape` | `SplitterHandleShape shape = SplitterHandleShape::NoHandle` |  |
| `crossSize` | `int crossSize = 16` | Extent across the split line (the "thickness" direction). The splitter strip grows to fit this, so a 16 px handle on a 4 px splitter widens the strip to 16 px and centres the 4 px line inside it. |
| `axisLength` | `int axisLength = 0` | Extent along the split line. &lt;= 0 means auto: crossSize for a bare handle, or just enough to wrap the icon group when containsIcons is set. |
| `cornerRadius` | `float cornerRadius = 4.0f` | Corner radius for SplitterHandleShape::RoundedSquare. |
| `position` | `float position = 0.5f` | Position along the split line, 0 = start, 0.5 = centred, 1 = end. |
| `color` | `Color color = Color(235, 235, 235, 255)` |  |
| `hoverColor` | `Color hoverColor = Color(205, 220, 248, 255)` |  |
| `activeColor` | `Color activeColor = Color(150, 185, 240, 255)` |  |
| `borderColor` | `Color borderColor = Color(160, 160, 160, 255)` | Transparent = no border |
| `borderWidth` | `float borderWidth = 1.0f` |  |
| `imagePath` | `std::string imagePath` | Image (SVG or raster) drawn as, or inside, the handle. With SplitterHandleShape::Image the image IS the handle. With any drawn shape the image is centred on top of it and the grip is suppressed. Supply an asset matching the orientation - a tall one for a Horizontal split pane (vertical split line), a wide one for a … |
| `imageFit` | `ImageFitMode imageFit = ImageFitMode::Fill` |  |
| `imageAsMask` | `bool imageAsMask = false` | Draw the image as a mask tinted with imageColor, for monochrome glyphs. Transparent imageColor follows the handle's state color. |
| `imageColor` | `Color imageColor = Colors::Transparent` |  |
| `showGrip` | `bool showGrip = true` | Grip lines drawn inside the handle. Suppressed when the handle carries icons or an image, since those take that space. |
| `gripLineCount` | `int gripLineCount = 3` |  |
| `gripSpacing` | `int gripSpacing = 3` |  |
| `gripThickness` | `float gripThickness = 1.0f` |  |

| `containsIcons` | `bool containsIcons = true` | When true (default) the icon group of this splitter is drawn inside the handle, and an auto-sized handle grows to wrap it. When false, handle and icons are positioned independently (see SplitterIconStyle::position). |
